title: Bianca Di Trieste - 2x Plug Plants - Italian Courgette
description: The Bianca Di Trieste Italian Courgette plug plants are perfect for both indoor and outdoor cultivation in temperate climates. These edible vegetables thrive in summer with medium sun and water, making them child-safe and easy to grow. Made in the United Kingdom, these clumping plants come in a pack of 2x, making them a fantastic addition to any garden or patio for those looking to enjoy the benefits of homegrown produce.
